manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Changeling Titan must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Titan for its mana cost.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
